text: Today is the hardest day I've had as CEO of Productboard. We're transforming the company into an AI-only organization built around Productboard Spark , and we've parted ways with over 30% of our team. I want to talk about the people first. That matters most right now. How we're taking care of our departing teammates Every person affected has received a severance package, extended healthcare coverage, and transition support. We've communicated the full details to them directly. Beyond the financial package, we're doing everything we can to help them land well. If you're in my network and you're hiring, these are sharp, talented people who built a company that thousands of product teams rely on. Why we're doing this Twelve years ago, we started Productboard with an almost radical belief: that great products aren't accidents. They come from people who care deeply, who listen obsessively, and who don't stop until they've built something that truly matters. That belief hasn't changed. What has changed is the world around it. AI is collapsing the process layer of building software. The tools of the last decade, including ours, were built to help product teams centralize information, organize backlogs, track progress. AI agents don't need any of that. The mechanics of product development are being automated away. But there's something AI will never replace. Judgment. Taste. Intuition. The ability to make the right call when the data is ambiguous and the stakes are high. That's product craft, and it has never been more valuable. That's why we embarked on the journey to build Spark almost two years ago. Not as an assistant, but as a knowledge engine that makes product makers better at the thing that actually matters: great product decisions, grounded in deep customer knowledge and competitive context. Instead of spending most of their time gathering and organizing information just to stay informed, product makers can think deeply, decide boldly, and ship products that matter. Back in February, our board and I aligned on a conviction: Spark is the future of this company, and we need an organization built to make it succeed. Once we reached that conviction, the question wasn't whether to restructure. It was whether to do it all at once or stretch it out over months. I believe in being straight with people. A slow bleed of ongoing cuts is worse for everyone: for morale, for focus, for the trust our customers and team place in us. So we made the full change now, in one clear move. AI-only is not a label. It's an operating model. Fewer people, every person at a higher altitude. Less process, more craft. Less overhead, more impact. This is now the leanest, fastest, most focused version of Productboard that has ever existed. And I believe it's the strongest. A decision at this scale is never going to be perfect in every detail. But I have deep confidence in this team's ability to figure things out as we go. That's always been one of our greatest strengths, and it's what I'm counting on now. Everything Else Did. Yonatan Orpeli 7 months ago To those who are leaving Your work is in the walls of this company. That's a fact, and no restructure changes it. This was a structural decision, not a judgment on your talent or your contributions. Thank you for everything you gave Productboard. I mean that deeply. You will thrive wherever you go next. To those who are staying This was my call, and I stand behind it. What I'm asking of you now is to lock in and build the future together. Your opportunity just got bigger. You will own more, ship more, and have more direct impact than you would at a larger company. The skills you develop here over the next year, building one of the first truly AI-native companies from the ground up, where learning velocity matters as much as shipping. What you learn here doesn't just make you faster today, it makes you more valuable for the next decade of your career. To our customers You're the reason we started this journey. Back in 2024, we looked at where product management was heading and made a clear-eyed decision: AI would fundamentally reshape how the best product teams work. We committed to that future because we've always been singularly focused on giving you the most valuable product management solution in the market. That focus hasn't wavered. It's what drove every decision behind today's announcement. We're not starting over. We're building on everything we've built together. Our entire product lineup is getting "Spark'd". The platform capabilities you depend on today, the ones we've refined over twelve years, become the foundation that powers Spark. This is evolution, not replacement. Here's what this means in practice. Every person at Productboard now operates with AI at the core of their daily work. We're not theorizing about AI transformation. We're doing it, across every function, every workflow, every decision. That lived experience compounds directly into what we build for you and how we guide you. The people serving you will be practitioners, not evangelists. They'll know what works because they use it every day. And because we're a more focused team with AI amplifying everything we do, you're going to see us ship faster than we ever have. We're well-capitalized and investing aggressively into Spark and the platform behind it. More innovation, more frequently, with deeper craft behind it. We want to be your partner into the AI era of product management. Not just as a tool you log into, but as the team that helps you navigate this shift with confidence. That's the commitment we're making today. Looking ahead We have twelve years of hard-earned market knowledge. Thousands of customer relationships. A trusted brand. Capital to invest. And now, a product vision that fully matches the ambition and mission we've carried since day one: make products that matter, together. The window to define AI-first product management will not stay open forever. We are moving decisively. Twelve years ago, we said great products don't happen by accident. That's still true. What's changed is that the people who believe it now have tools powerful enough to match their ambition. Let's keep making products that matter, together. Hubert
